{{Quote|We've got Gamble Squadron en route to your position to provide some extra firepower.|A clone naval officer, to a Jedi Knight during the battle on Mustafar|<ref name="CWA" />}}
'''Gamble Squadron''' was a [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL-B Y-wing starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]], part of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Led by [[Gamble One]], it was involved in a [[Battle of Mustafar (Clone Wars)|battle]] on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] against [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] [[Foreman/Legends|Foreman]] [[Wat Tambor/Legends|Wat Tambor's]] forces.<ref name="CWA" />
